svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 44 x 2 mm tube about 568 mm long and trim to fit.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It rises at 69.5 degrees from the nose beam to the head tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Foot: cut at 20.5 degrees off square so it stands flat on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the nose beam's top, centred on the beam (30 mm from its rear face).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top: fish-mouth it onto the 50 mm head tube at 40.5 degrees included

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: angle (print a tube-mitre template). Its axis meets the head tube's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: axis 100 mm above the head tube's bottom end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Centre to centre along its axis: 559 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Welded on later (sheet 105): two cradle tabs on its top (rider side),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and the controller plate on its left side, low down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: with the frame in the jig, the tube sits flat on the beam and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the head tube's angle reads 70 degrees from the ground plane.
